variants.name: Chicken, 7 pcs / 140 g
variants.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Chicken Bones Strong XS are made of tasty beefhide and delicious chicken breast and give strong, long-lasting chewing fun for toy dogs under 5 kg. Their firm consistency makes them an extra tough chew, ideal for dogs with a particularly strong instinct to chew. The natural abrasive action of chewing helps remove tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked, free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added GMOs or gluten. Pack of 7 bones, 140 g.
variants.feeding_instructions: Feed 1 treat over a course of five days. Do not exceed 1 treat in a five day period. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Select a chew slightly larger than your pet's mouth. Always provide fresh water. Supervise your dog while chewing.

variants.name: S, Chicken, 55 g
variants.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Chicken Bone Strong S is made of tasty beefhide with delicious chicken breast inside and gives strong, long-lasting chewing fun for small dogs weighing 5–10 kg. Its firm consistency makes it an extra-tough chew, ideal for dogs with a particularly strong instinct to chew. While keeping your dog busy, the natural abrasive action of chewing removes tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked and free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added GMOs or gluten. One bone, 55 g.
variants.feeding_instructions: Feed 1 treat over a course of four days. Do not exceed 1 treat in a four day period. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Select a chew slightly larger than your pet's mouth. Balance food intake and exercise with this reward snack. Always provide fresh water. Supervise your dog while chewing.
